Spaceworthy '''battle droids''' were utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[the Graveyard]]. They were a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was capable of moving in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. They were armed with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. The Empire used them, as well as [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]], as part of their trap for the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].
